serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: …
It seems like I got here much smoother than ever before. No wobbly feet or dizziness…
I wonder if it's a good sign or bad…
Every time before this one, I could feel my body crashing down against the sand filled with microplastic, but this time I went out much quicker.
I need to get over it and focus. Who knows what kind of mental torture I will be a subject of today?
